summary: Package definition for the database library. It lists its libraries and defines two scripts: a manual push script and a migrate script that is deliberately disabled.
purpose: Describes the database package and gives the team commands for pushing schema changes and for blocking migrations.
why: The comments record a 2026-08-07 incident where an automatic push proposed dropping four compass tables, so push is manual only and migrate is disabled.
how: It names the package and its entry points. The push script runs drizzle-kit push with the config file. The migrate script prints a disabled message and exits with an error. It lists drizzle-orm, drizzle-zod, pg and zod as libraries, plus type helpers and drizzle-kit as development tools.
inputs: Commands typed by a person, such as pnpm push or pnpm migrate.
outputs: Runs the push tool, or prints a disabled message from the migrate script.
risks: The push script can drop tables if the proposed change is accepted. The comments forbid adding a force variant and calling push from any script or workflow. The full text of the migrate script is cut off in the packet, so its exact message cannot be checked here.
debug: If a push is proposed with drops, stop and check with the owner. If a pnpm command is missing, check the scripts section.
